scenes.title: Situation A: staff hands items to Security
Situation B: Security hands items to CBTO

lines.text: Security fills in the Acknowledgement of Receipt and brings the phone.
This guide is for staff handing items to Security, CBTO staff, and witnesses.
Before, this was a printed paper form, signed with a pen.
Now it is the same form, on the Security officer’s phone, and the signed PDF is saved automatically.
Every form works in four steps.
Security fills the form, and hands you the phone.
You check and sign.
Then the phone goes back, and Security signs and saves.
Blue is Security.
Orange is you.
There is nothing to install, and no account.
Read the form before you sign, and sign only for yourself.
One form, two situations.
In Situation A, staff hand items to Security.
In Situation B, Security hands items to CBTO.
In both, Security fills the form, the Recipient signs first, and a witness signs.
Situation A: you hand items to Security.
Security signs first, as Recipient.
In the app, the order is: Recipient, Security staff.
Handed over by, you.
Then the witness.
Security types all names, items and IDs first.
You only check and sign.
Security passes you the phone.
The orange box shows your name.
Check your name, your role, and the items listed.
If everything is correct, sign with your finger and tap ‘Confirm’.
Tap ‘Clear’ if you need to sign again.
Next, the witness does the same: check their own name, sign, and tap ‘Confirm’.
When the screen says so, the witness gives the phone back to Security.
Security saves the record.
Situation B: Security hands items to CBTO.
CBTO staff sign first, as Recipient.
In the app, the order is: Recipient, CBTO staff.
Handed over by, Security staff.
Then the witness.
Check every item listed is what you received.
If you are the CBTO staff member, you sign first.
Scroll up and check every item you received.
Sign with your finger and tap ‘Confirm’.
Tap ‘Clear’ to sign again.
Pass the phone back to Security.
Security signs as ‘Handed over by’.
Then the witness checks, signs and confirms.
The witness does the same: check their own name, sign, and tap ‘Confirm’.
When the screen says so, the witness gives the phone back to Security.
Security saves the record.
This is a real Saved screen from a TEST record.
The Record ID is in the PDF file name.
Security staff email the PDF to you.
Keep it for your records.
Remember: check your name and role, and read the details before signing.
Don’t sign for someone else, or if the details are wrong.
Don’t close the app, press Back, or take photos of the screen.
Your signature goes into one signed PDF per form, with every signature and a Record ID.
It is kept in a restricted AirAsia folder, with a record log, and a PDF copy is emailed to you.
